name: Quicksilver
author: E. T. Carter
description: A pool of liquid metal in a shallow dark dish on a dark studio floor, out of which lobes rise, merge and part on slow orbits of their own, never settling. A true mirror of the studio round it: the dark floor, the sweep behind, the spot overhead and two soft strip lights in the theme colours, so the theme reaches it only in reflection.

sculpture.label: A pool of liquid metal in a dark dish. Lobes rise from it, merge, part and fall back, never settling, and it mirrors the room round it.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: How fast the lobes rise, merge and fall back; 0 freezes the liquid mid-motion.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How far the pointer orbits the camera round the piece; 0 ignores the mouse.
